All 6 outstanding anomalies have been investigated and closed. Summary:

## Investigation Summary

| Anomaly ID | Metric_hour | Metric | Reported Δ% | Disposition |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `4988b422` | 2026-07-10 18:00 | ctr | +254% | **false_positive** |
| `a558a74e` | 2026-07-10 14:00 | requests | +21.7% | **false_positive** |
| `e8103618` | 2026-07-10 08:00 | revenue | +33.7% | **false_positive** |
| `8c5ee70c` | 2026-07-09 23:00 | fill_rate | -18.0% | **confirmed** ⚠️ |
| `06b7fd90` | 2026-07-09 23:00 | fill_rate | -15.9% | **confirmed** ⚠️ |
| `88f6d85f` | 2026-07-09 23:00 | fill_rate | -15.5% | **confirmed** ⚠️ |

### False positives (3)
- **ctr (18:00)**: global ctr only moved +7-13% vs. baseline; historical 21-day check showed the value was well within normal range. Best-matching slice (MEA/banner) had just 6 clicks/hr — Poisson noise.
- **requests (14:00)**: only +4.6% vs. 7-day baseline (essentially flat vs. prior hour). 21-day series shows a gradual week-over-week growth trend, not a spike.
- **revenue (08:00)**: only +0.9% vs. baseline; 21-day series shows $25.54 is a mid-pack, entirely typical value for that hour.

### Confirmed real incident (3 — same root cause)
All three fill_rate anomalies at **2026-07-09 23:00** (likely triple-detected by different baseline methods) trace to the **same genuine incident**:

- **NAM region, tier_1 (premium) publishers** suffered a sustained **~36-hour fill_rate collapse** from **2026-07-08 12:00 → 2026-07-09 23:00 UTC**, dropping to 0.58–0.66 from a normal ~0.82–0.83 baseline (-23.5% at tier_1, -17.9% at tier_2).
- The drop was **broad across all ad_formats** within NAM (ruling out a single creative-format bug) but concentrated in **premium inventory** (tier_3 barely moved, -3.8%) — pointing to a **demand-side/SSP partner issue** affecting NAM premium fill specifically.
- Fill rate **snapped back sharply** to 0.75–0.79 at exactly 2026-07-10 00:00 UTC — a cliff-edge recovery pattern inconsistent with random noise, strongly indicative of a real operational incident (e.g., partner outage or config issue) that should be escalated to the demand/supply ops team if not already resolved.

All 6 anomalies are now closed in `gold.metric_anomalies` with full evidence and RCA descriptions attached.
